name: She Demands My Allegiance!!
source:
Ra-Fell is a Dark Miasma Dragon who receives a very special guest at his lair... Seren, the princess of the Wings-Sea kingdom! She has come to make a very special demand...

[From [url=https://meltynana.itch.io/she-demands-my-allegiance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉菲尔是一条黑暗瘴气龙，他在自己的巢穴中接待了一位非常特别的客人……塞伦，翼海王国的公主！她来是为了提出一个很特别的要求……

[来自[url=https://meltynana.itch.io/she-demands-my-allegiance]itch.io[/url]]
